Delhi Metro Gates May Close for October 10 Protest

Ahead of a planned protest on October 10, Delhi Police have requested the closure of entry and exit gates at 57 Delhi Metro stations. Senior police officials stated that these restrictions, covering stations across all parts of Delhi, indicate preparations for potential crowd mobilization from various areas of the city.
